description:
Rock. Paper. Scissors. AI.

Play the world’s most famous hand game against ChatGPT.

Choose Rock, Paper, or Scissors and watch as ChatGPT makes its move. Every round is instant, making it perfect for a quick challenge, settling a debate, or testing your luck against AI.

Features

* Play against ChatGPT
* Instant results every round
* Clean and simple interface
* Unlimited games
* Fun AI-powered experience

Can you outsmart the AI, or will ChatGPT predict your next move?

Pick your weapon. Make your choice. Let the battle begin.
